text_block_list.text:
With the debut date decided, we were 
pouring even more effort into training one 
day when――

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
—Mmm♪ The cakes for afternoon tea here are 
so fluffy and delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right! So super sweet~♡ I just love ones 
with lots of whipped cream~!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
You're so right, Vivlos-chan♡ What's your 
favorite, Trainer-san~?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Geez, Mom. Trainer-san just got here."

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, haven't quite settled down yet, huh? 
Sowwyy, for calling you out so suddenly.

Verxina's... that is to say, the sisters' 
parents, are both very, very well-known to 
the public.

Her father is an active baseball player, 
renowned as a big-hearted, open-minded 
family man devoted to his wife.

Her mother had once been an idol-like 
Umamusume. Though she never won a graded 
stakes race, she commanded an undeniable 
presence in the racing world.

"A celebrity I've only seen on TV is right 
before my eyes... On top of that 
nervousness—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, want to buy a souvenir for Cheval on 
our way back? It looks like you can get 
takeout here."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm buying it! It's gotta be something you 
wanna post on Umastagram, right? ♡

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Then Mama wants to take photos as a 
souvenir for Papa♪ Let's take a selfie!
choice_data_list:
(The three of them lined up together is 
dazzling...!)

text_block_list.text:
Her mother's glamorous nature felt like it 
had especially influenced Vivlos's aura. 
As that thought crossed my mind—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos, you like matcha scones, right? 
You can have Big Sis's share too—"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Mommy's already full, so I want to 
split it in half with Mommy♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Really? Yay♪

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Verxina-chan, would you mind finishing 
this strawberry jelly? You like it, right? 
Mama is all full~.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Then... I'll take it. Thank you.

I felt Vivlos took after their mother... 
but the way she cared for her daughters 
closely resembled Verxina caring for her 
younger sisters.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Do you want some too, Trainer? Big Sis, 
why don't you feed them~?!"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~! Verxina-chan, so boldâ¡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even Mom...? Ugh, I'm not doing it 
anymore!

And so, surrounded by the warm and loving 
family, my tension gradually melted away. 
The wonderful time flew by in an instant—

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Right, right, Verxina-chan! Have you 
already decided on your main racing goals?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: A big goal?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
You know how you plan and build everything 
up for the most important race? Mom used 
to run too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Well, she couldn't even make it to Open 
class. Even so, Verxina-chan... You're 
aiming for even greater heights, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I haven't told you 
my concrete goals yet either, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes. I—I'm aiming for the Tiara route!

It is the collective name for the major 
Classic-class route races: the Oka Sho, 
the Yushun Himba, and the Shuka Sho... A 
series of top-class races.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It is all because of the radiance that the 
Tiara gives off.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"The other major route in the Classic 
Year... The Classic Triple Crown of the 
Satsuki Sho, Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby), and Kikuka Sho is wonderful, but—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"What I want to show everyone... is a 
glorious pinnacle."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Just like those who walked the Tiara route 
before me, I want to lead everyone with 
strength and grace.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—So that you may march forward without 
hesitation. As your older sister, I wish 
to be the guiding destination before you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
With the gentle radiance of the Tiara, you 
can aim for it with confidence, can you 
not?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
In particular, the Oaks is a race won by 
those who have left a profound impact on 
future generations.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I definitely want to win!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~, that's our Verxina-chan! So cool!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Then with that momentum, go for it! The 
Triple Tiara♡
choice_data_list:
(The title for going undefeated on the 
Tiara route...!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Only three people have ever achieved it, 
you know? It's not that simple.

"I could instantly picture Verxina 
claiming a noble victory under the 
watchful eyes of her little sisters."
choice_data_list: I bet a tiara would look wonderful on you.
A tiara would suit you beautifully.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~! That's insaneâ¡ Trainer-san's 
heart is gonna melt~â¡

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... You must really think Verxina 
is wonderful, huh?
choice_data_list:
I signed a contract with her because I 
fell in love with her running.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ! Wah~~♡ Does that mean~~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, you don't need to say another 
word!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Still... thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If that happens... my little sisters will 
surely be proud of me, too—

Afterward, while waiting for Verxina and 
Vivlos who had gone out shopping— I found 
myself alone with their mother.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Sorry about springing this on you 
today! Let's properly schedule it next 
time! I'll invite Dad too♪

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. Verxina is such a hard worker, 
isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I knew it... You already understand, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since she was little, she's felt a 
strong sense of duty to protect her little 
sisters—"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
"—Verxina, you had a fever?! I'm so sorry, 
Mommy didn't notice at all...! It must've 
been so tough staying home alone, I'm so 
sorry...!"

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"N-No... I'm fine. Because... today was 
Chevalier and Vivlos's big recital..."

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I'm the big sister, so... house-sitting 
is no problem! Hey, hey, did we both do a 
good job...?"

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if the sound of Cheval's 
castanets carried properly...? Did Vivlos 
sing well, I wonder—"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure there will come a time when it 
gets painful being all on your own.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
“However, please believe in Verxina-chan's 
strength at all times…… and always watch 
over her.”

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Both Papa and I are busy with work, so 
there may be times we can't rush over 
right away. Even so, we're always here to 
support you!"
choice_data_list: Yes, I'll be counting on you...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—So-rry to keep you waiting! I managed to 
get the souvenir for Cheval-chi♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Trainer. ...Were you all right?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how mean, Verxina-chan! Mommy didn't 
do anything weird at aall, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That's not it, Mommy! Big sis is, you see, 
being jealous!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, the entire time we were shopping, 
you were just worrying, 'What if Mom is 
saying something weird to him?'... over 
and over!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Vivlos!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
It's been so long since I last saw 
Verxina-chan flustered♡ So cute~♡

A smile naturally spread across my face. 
Growing up in an atmosphere like this is 
surely why giving her all for her family 
comes so naturally to her—

A few days later... Verxina's expression 
took a complete turn—tightening with sharp 
determination.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, one more time. Please let me 
see that footage again.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "I shall claim the Triple Tiara."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh...! While the Classic Triple Crown is 
an honorable title... may we ask why 
you've chosen to challenge the Triple 
Tiara route?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "It's quite simple."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "Because the tiara... suits me so well."
choice_data_list: (So you stand in my way after all...)

text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna also declared her intention to 
aim for the Tiara route— explicitly aiming 
to achieve the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Because tiaras suit me, you say? Just 
for... that...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...In that case. It definitely wouldn't 
suit you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Don't you agree, Trainer? After all—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That proud radiance belongs to none other 
than me!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—I will not hand the glory of the Tiara 
over to her!
